title: scopolia pendula
intro: Scopolia pendula, commonly known as Devil's Breath or Scopolia, is a plant species native to North America, belonging to the family Campanulaceae. The health benefits of Scopolia pendula include its potential to reduce anxiety and stress, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as a sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Scopolia pendula include alkaloids such as scopolamine and hyoscyamine, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
